title: Lipschitz frequency dependence of invariant graphs in parameterized finitely differentiable Diophantine KAM theory
author: Abed Bounemoura
work: Positive measure of KAM tori for finitely differentiable Hamiltonians
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 7 (2020), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.137
difficulty_reason: Classical analytic smoothing and a KAM step do not alone preserve frequency-Lipschitz invariant graphs at the stated finite differentiability threshold. The author adapts the weighted truncation and iteration to control the simultaneous small-divisor and composition losses, and derives sharper difference estimates for the graph maps than for the conjugacies. The convergence argument then proves the stated graph regularity and uniform frequency-Lipschitz bounds without assuming such bounds for the dynamics.
